title: Find-a-Line
description: The application: queue, worker, searches, quick lane, accounts, use and storage, the outside services, the routes, the housekeeping, the coverage and the speed of downloads and computing (docs/monitoring.md, rows F1-F19).

list.name: Deployments
list.expr: count by (version) (findaline_build_info) unless count by (version) (findaline_build_info offset 5m)

panels.title: At a glance (F1-F10): red needs attention
Worker (F1)
panels.description: Workers with a live lease (renewed every 5 s, valid 30 s). Alert: none for 2 min.

panels.title: Queue (F2)
panels.description: Searches waiting or running against queue_max (new searches are refused at 100 %). Alert above 80 %.

panels.title: Waiting (F2)
panels.description: Age of the oldest queued or downloaded search not yet running. Alert above 30 min.

panels.title: Running (F2)
panels.description: Searches in each phase now (the worker's slots: the chart below).

panels.title: Internal (F3)
panels.description: In the last 24 hours: searches failed by an unexpected exception ("internal error, ref ..." for the user). Alert on any.

targets.expr: (sum(findaline_jobs_finished_total{error="internal"}) or max(findaline_build_info) * 0) - (sum(findaline_jobs_finished_total{error="internal"} offset 24h) or max(findaline_build_info offset 24h) * 0)

panels.title: Failed (F3)
panels.description: Share of the searches finished in the last hour that failed. Alert above 30 % (at least 3 finished).

targets.expr: ((sum(findaline_jobs_finished_total{status="failed"}) or max(findaline_build_info) * 0) - (sum(findaline_jobs_finished_total{status="failed"} offset 1h) or max(findaline_build_info offset 1h) * 0)) / ((sum(findaline_jobs_finished_total) or max(findaline_build_info) * 0) - (sum(findaline_jobs_finished_total offset 1h) or max(findaline_build_info offset 1h) * 0)) * 100

panels.title: Quick (F5)
panels.description: Age of the oldest waiting estimate, profile or place lookup. Alert above 30 s.

panels.title: Disk (F9)
panels.description: Free space of the data folder as the application sees it; it refuses searches below 20 GB (FINDALINE_LIMIT_FREE_DISK_GB_MIN). The disk's alert is A3.

panels.title: Pending (F6)
panels.description: Accounts waiting for approval on the Admin page. Info: a new one.

panels.title: Reports (F8)
panels.description: Problem reports not marked done (Admin page). Info: a new one.

panels.title: Refused (F7)
panels.description: Requests refused by a rate or a quota in the last hour (audit). Alert: more than 20 and 3 times the hourly mean of the day before.

panels.title: Active (F7)
panels.description: Signed-in sessions seen within the window (15 min, 24 h).

panels.title: Area today (F14, F18)
panels.description: km² of the searches finished in the last 24 hours (computed; in total: the panel to the right) and km² of new terrain data downloaded for them (the rest came from the cache).

targets.expr: (sum(findaline_area_km2_total) or max(findaline_build_info) * 0) - (sum(findaline_area_km2_total offset 24h) or max(findaline_build_info offset 24h) * 0)
(sum(findaline_download_km2_total{role="terrain"}) or max(findaline_build_info) * 0) - (sum(findaline_download_km2_total{role="terrain"} offset 24h) or max(findaline_build_info offset 24h) * 0)

panels.title: In total (F14)
panels.description: All finished searches with an area (also from before the monitoring).

panels.title: Users (F6)
panels.description: Approved accounts.

panels.title: Version (F10)
panels.description: The application's version (pyproject.toml). A new version is marked on the charts.

panels.title: Searches by status (F2)
panels.description: Waiting (queued, ready: downloaded) and running (downloading, computing); new searches are refused at queue_max.

panels.title: Running against the slots (F2)
panels.description: All slots busy and searches waiting: the worker is the bottleneck.

panels.title: Oldest waiting search (F2)
panels.description: Alert above 30 min (the dashed line).

panels.title: Worker's lease (F1)
panels.description: A heartbeat every 5 s; a lease older than 30 s (the dashed line) is dead. Alert: no worker alive for 2 min.

panels.title: Finished per hour by result (F3)
panels.description: Searches finished in the hour before each point.

panels.title: Failed per hour by error (F3)
panels.description: The error code of the failure, or its category (time_limit, worker_stopped, internal, interrupted, other). Alert on any internal one.

panels.title: Mean time per phase (F4)
panels.description: Mean of the searches finished in the 3 hours before each point: waiting in the queue, download, ready (downloaded, waiting for a compute slot), computing (stacked: the whole search). Searches from before ready was stored count that wait in download.

panels.title: Mean duration by result (F4)
panels.description: From the request to the end, mean of the 3 hours before each point.

panels.title: Quick lane waiting (F5)
panels.description: Estimates, profiles and place lookups wait for the worker's one quick process. Alert: the oldest above 30 s (the dashed line).

panels.title: Quick answers per minute (F5)
panels.description: ok; no_worker (503: no worker), busy (the wait's limit), gone (the client left). Counted by the web process since its start.

panels.title: Area per day: computed and downloaded (F14, F18)
panels.description: km² of the searches finished in each day (UTC) of the last 30 days, repeats included (computed), and km² of new terrain data downloaded (each place once until its tiles expire: the cache).

panels.title: Searches per day (F14)
panels.description: Finished searches with an area in each day (UTC) of the last 30 days.

panels.title: Area by country of the search (F14)
panels.description: km² in total by the country of the area's centre (unknown: before the monitoring, or no country).

panels.title: Searches by country (F14)
panels.description: Finished searches with an area in total.

panels.title: Users who searched in each country (F15, A)
panels.description: Users with a finished search in the country (one user may count in several).

panels.title: Users by country, browser's time zone (F15, B)
panels.description: Accounts by the country of their browser's time zone (unknown: not reported yet).

panels.title: Sessions (F7)
panels.description: Signed-in sessions (not visitors).

panels.title: Actions in the last hour (F7)
panels.description: Audit events in the hour before each point: sign-ins, searches added, share links, favourites, refusals, ...

panels.title: Refused in the last hour (F7)
panels.description: Requests refused by a rate limit or a quota (audit). Alert: more than 20 in an hour (the dashed line) and 3 times the hourly mean of the day before.

panels.title: Cache by folder (F9)
panels.description: Top-level folders of cache/, measured by the worker's housekeeping.

panels.title: Free disk and the 30-day forecast (F9)
panels.description: The application refuses searches below 20 GB (the dashed line).

targets.legendFormat: in 30 days at the rate of 7

panels.title: Requests per hour by host (F11)
panels.description: Every request of the worker's processes to a data source, Nominatim, Overpass, Geofabrik or an orthophoto service, each retry counted (GDAL's own retries are not seen). Counted since phase 3.

panels.title: Failed share per host, 30 min (F11)
panels.description: Requests that did not end ok or not found (HTTP 4xx, 5xx, timeouts, connection errors) per host; the alert fires above 20 % with at least 10 requests in 30 min.

panels.title: Outcomes per hour (F11)
panels.description: ok, not_found (a tile outside the data, an unknown place), http_4xx, http_5xx, timeout, connection, other; all hosts together.

panels.title: Downloaded per hour by host (F11)
panels.description: Bytes of the answers' bodies.

panels.title: Mean time per request by host (F11)
panels.description: Seconds per request over the last hour.

panels.title: Requests per second by route (F12)
panels.description: The web process's requests by the template of the matched route (unmatched: no route); from zero after a restart of web.

panels.title: Requests per second by status (F12)
panels.description: All routes; method and class of the status.

panels.title: Mean time per route (F12)
panels.description: Seconds per request (the event stream left out).

panels.title: Open event streams (F12)
panels.description: The pages open now (each holds one stream).

panels.title: Last round (F13)
panels.description: Time since the worker's housekeeping last ended (every 6 h); the alert fires after 18 h.

panels.title: Removed in the last round (F13)
panels.description: .part files, events, quick answers, usage rows, audit events, work folders.

panels.title: Duration of the round (F13)
panels.description: Seconds of the last round.

panels.title: Covered (F17)
panels.description: km² searched at least once: the union of the areas of all finished searches (the worker's housekeeping, every 6 h).

panels.title: Covered over time (F17)
panels.description: km² searched at least once.

panels.title: Searches per cell of 0.25 degrees (F17)
panels.description: Finished searches whose area touches each cell (counted by the worker's housekeeping; no users). The marker sits in the middle of its cell; its size and colour grow with the count.

panels.title: Speed of downloads and computing (F18, F19)
Download speed per layer, Mpx/s (F18)
panels.description: Millions of pixels (the data's own resolution) per second of a tile's download, over 3 hours: the speed of one connection, comparable between sources (km²/s at 1 m). Each search downloads several tiles at once.

panels.title: Download speed per layer, km²/s (F18)
panels.description: Square kilometres per second of a tile's download, over 3 hours: what a user waits for on each source.

panels.title: Waiting for tile locks and host slots (F18)
panels.description: Share of a tile's time spent waiting for its lock (another search downloads it) or a slot of its host (other downloads of that host), over 3 hours: high when parallel downloads compete, not when a service slows down.

panels.title: Tiles found in the cache (F18)
panels.description: Share of the tiles searches needed that were cached already, per layer, over a day.

panels.title: New data per day by role (F18)
panels.description: km² of the tiles downloaded in each day (UTC) of the last 30 days: terrain, surface, the water mask and gap filling (done while computing).

panels.title: Computed per day by resolution, Mpx (F19)
panels.description: Millions of pixels (km² / resolution²) of the searches finished in each day (UTC) of the last 30 days, by the class of their resolution (up to so many metres): the measure of the compute quota.

panels.title: Seconds of computing per Mpx by resolution (F19)
panels.description: Seconds of the computing phase per million pixels of the finished searches, over 7 days: whether the cost follows the pixels at every resolution (the compute quota assumes it).

panels.title: Mean time per step of computing (F19)
panels.description: Seconds of each step of the computing phase per finished search, over a day: 1 the grids (and gap filling), 2 the slopes and anchors, 3 the pairs, 4 coordinates, groups and profiles, 5 saving, orthophoto its tiles (downloaded within step 5, holding the compute slot), other between steps and tiles.

panels.title: Mean CPU seconds per step of computing (F19)
panels.description: CPU seconds of each step of the computing phase per finished search, over a day: the whole process with numba's threads, so CPU seconds over the seconds of the same step (the panel beside) is the number of cores the step kept busy. Searches from before migration 16 have none.

panels.title: Line search: seconds and CPU per stage (F19)
panels.description: Seconds and CPU seconds of the stages of the line search (steps 2 and 3) per finished search that ran them, over a day: finding anchors, their prominence and drop, the sag estimator's table (--model sag), the free directions of the anchors, the pairs, the pixel-by-pixel check of the lines found. A tiled area sums its tiles.

panels.title: Line search funnel per day (F19)
panels.description: The counts of the line search of the searches finished in each day (UTC) of the last 30 days, from the grids and anchors to the lines (log scale): anchors found, kept after the prominence and drop limits, with an open direction, those pairs start from; candidate pairs, checked pixel by pixel, found; valid lines, left out by the line limits, the lines of the tiles' cores.
